title: Maadi Tara Mandiriye (Non Stop Dandiya Mix)
description: A 10-track Gujarati Garba and Dandiya programme led by Falguni Pathak and Sudesh Bhosle, preserved as the original 2000 Nonstop Dandiya Mix edition with exact Sony YouTube chapter playback.
aliases: Maadi Tara Mandiriye Nonstop Dandiya Mix
label: Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
notes: Amazon publishes the 10-track Non Stop Dandiya Mix as a Various Artists release with exact per-track performers; regional pages show August 17 or August 18, 2000. Apple independently places Dholida Dhol Dhimo Dhimo on Maadi Tara Mandiriye on August 17, 2000, so 2000-08-17 is retained as the canonical release date while the regional one-day variance remains documented. Some later provider track pages display September 1, 2008, indicating a later digital/reissue surface rather than a new original recording date. Falguni Pathak performs on tracks 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10; tracks 1, 2 and 5 are Sudesh Bhosle solo, so the release is not falsely normalized to a Falguni-only artist credit. Sony Music Bhakti's 2025 official full-programme upload publishes all ten song names, exact singers and centisecond-resolved chapter starts; chapter gaps match the provider track durations, allowing truthful YouTube chapter routing without inferred boundaries.
